grok.pulse: NQ heads into Sunday 6 PM ET reopen on the back foot after Fri's -2.9% Nasdaq / worst month since Mar 2025 on AI capex doubts; fresh Gulf risk (Dammam industrial fire, LNG tanker hit) keeps oil bid, offset by day-3 US-Iran talks in Doha, Hormuz traffic back near pre-war levels and record TQQQ dip-buying.
grok.bias: risk-off — AI capex/FCF hangover (GOOGL/AMZN/INTC) plus weekend Gulf energy headlines into a loaded week (AAPL/PLTR Mon AMC, midterms Tue, AMD Tue AMC, NFP Fri); Iran deal progress is the main upside offset.
items: Gulf footage via X (~7:14 AM ET): huge fire/black smoke over Dammam industrial area, Saudi Eastern Province; unverified claims of a Houthi drone on an oil site, no Saudi statement yet — Bearish NQ (oil spike risk at open)
@FirstSquawk (~6:18 AM ET): Iranian negotiators in Doha for 3rd day of talks with Qatari mediators; Iran signals Hormuz could reopen in 48h if sanctions/funds demands met — Bullish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~6:02 AM ET): UAE's Gargash says trust with Iran 'shaken', Hormuz must return to pre-Feb 28 status quo, doesn't want new military round — Mixed NQ
Nakilat via X (Sun AM): Qatari LNG carrier Al Mayeda struck by unidentified objects in Gulf Fri evening, crew safe — Bearish NQ (energy premium)
Morgan Stanley via X (Sat): hedge funds de-grossed 7.8% from peak, biggest since 2016, net sold AI names 5 straight sessions; ~$1B into TQQQ after QQQ -3.5% — Mixed NQ (washout vs. AI trade cracks)
grok.trump: No market posts overnight (Sat was midterm TeleRallies). Per @WatcherGuru (~8:20 PM ET Sat): Trump 'not concerned' about the $6.3B Binance hack — 'We'll talk to North Korea about it.' Says Iran talks continue with no rush; military options still on the table.
grok.watch: Sun 6 PM ET futures reopen (gap risk on Dammam/Hormuz/oil); Mon 10 AM ET ISM Mfg; Mon AMC AAPL & PLTR; Tue Nov 3 midterms + SHOP BMO, AMD/ANET AMC, JOLTS; Wed UBER BMO, QCOM/ARM/APP AMC + Iran decision headlines; Thu jobless claims, IREN AMC; Fri 8:30 AM ET NFP.
